claim: Drinking boiled garlic water cures COVID-19 infection overnight.
explanation: WHO and medical experts confirm there is no scientific evidence that garlic water cures COVID-19 or viral respiratory illnesses.

claim: mRNA vaccines alter human DNA permanently and introduce programmable microchips.
explanation: mRNA never enters the nucleus of cells where DNA is stored, and vaccines contain lipid nanoparticles, not electronic chips.

claim: Holding your breath for 10 seconds without coughing proves you are free from coronavirus.
explanation: The breath-holding test cannot detect respiratory infections. Only validated RT-PCR or antigen tests provide accurate diagnosis.

claim: Consuming high doses of vitamin C and lemon juice cures advanced cancer without chemotherapy.
explanation: Clinical oncological studies show high vitamin C intake does not cure malignant tumors and replacing medical treatments is dangerous.

claim: 5G cellular radiation activates viral pathogens and causes flu-like epidemics.
explanation: Radiofrequency emissions cannot generate or transmit biological microorganisms. Extensive international studies found no link.

claim: Drinking silver nanoparticles (colloidal silver) acts as a universal natural antibiotic with zero side effects.
explanation: FDA warns colloidal silver is neither safe nor effective for treating diseases, and causes argyria (permanent skin discoloration) and organ damage.

claim: Aspirin mixed with honey and lime stops heart attacks instantly within 30 seconds.
explanation: Chewing aspirin can reduce blood clotting during myocardial infarction, but it does not stop heart attacks immediately; emergency services must be called.

claim: Flu vaccines increase your susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus by 400%.
explanation: Peer-reviewed CDC surveillance shows influenza vaccination confers broad protective effects without increasing secondary viral vulnerability.

claim: Microwaving food converts nutrients into carcinogenic radioactive particles.
explanation: Microwave ovens emit non-ionizing electromagnetic radiation that only excites water molecules to produce heat; no radioactivity is created.

claim: Inhaling steam with clove oil eliminates coronavirus from the lungs completely.
explanation: Lungs cannot withstand steam high enough to destroy pathogens without suffering thermal tissue damage and burns.

claim: Eating raw onions absorbs viral infections from household air.
explanation: An ancient folk myth. Cut onions do not act as sponges for airborne bacteria or viruses.

claim: Drinking cold water immediately after oily food causes heart attacks and intestinal cancer.
explanation: Digestive physiology maintains gastric temperature. Water does not solidify fats into fatal digestive blockages.

claim: Turmeric latte (haldi doodh) has been officially patented by the US government as a synthetic medicine.
explanation: The US patent office granted a patent on turmeric wound healing in 1995, but it was successfully revoked in 1997 after Indian CSIR challenged it.

claim: Placing a slice of raw potato on the soles of feet draws out toxins and reduces fever within minutes.
explanation: Fever is regulated by the brain hypothalamus. Potatoes do not extract systemic infections or bodily toxins through epidermal contact.

claim: Artificial sweeteners cause immediate kidney failure and brain tumors in humans.
explanation: FDA-approved sweeteners like aspartame and stevia are safe within acceptable daily intakes. Rodent mega-dose studies do not directly translate to human toxicities.

claim: Regular physical exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes.
explanation: Extensive randomized clinical trials and epidemiological evidence confirm 150 minutes of weekly moderate activity substantially lowers metabolic risks.

claim: Antibiotics are ineffective against viral infections such as colds and influenza.
explanation: Antibiotics target bacterial cellular structures and mechanisms; they have no biological effect against viruses.

claim: High dietary sodium intake is a major risk factor for hypertension and stroke.
explanation: Excess sodium elevates arterial blood pressure by increasing vascular fluid volume, contributing to cardiovascular events.

claim: Hand washing with soap physically dissolves the lipid envelope of coronaviruses.
explanation: Soap molecules are amphiphilic; their hydrophobic tails bind to viral lipid membranes, prying them apart and destroying viral integrity.

claim: Smoking tobacco remains the leading cause of preventable lung cancer worldwide.
explanation: Tobacco smoke contains over 70 recognized carcinogens that cause mutational damage to respiratory epithelial cells.

claim: UNESCO has declared Indian National Anthem Jana Gana Mana as the best national anthem in the world.
explanation: UNESCO has repeatedly confirmed it has never evaluated or awarded any national anthem as the world's best.

claim: New 2000 rupee currency notes issued by RBI contain an embedded nano-GPS chip tracking underground currency.
explanation: RBI and security printing officials explicitly clarified that currency notes have zero electronic components or GPS transponders.

claim: Government of India is offering free 500 rupee recharges to all citizens on the occasion of national elections.
explanation: PIB Fact Check confirmed the viral links are phishing scams designed to steal personal credentials; no such recharge scheme exists.

claim: UNESCO officially declared Narendra Modi as the best Prime Minister in the world.
explanation: UNESCO does not rate, rank, or award heads of state or government leaders.

claim: Government has mandated 18% GST on funeral services and religious cremations.
explanation: Funeral, burial, and crematorium services are completely exempt from GST under Schedule III of the CGST Act.

claim: Supreme Court ruled that WhatsApp chats will now show three blue ticks when intercepted by cyber police.
explanation: WhatsApp confirmed messages use end-to-end encryption. There are no three-tick or government surveillance status check marks.

claim: Drinking cow urine prevents cancer and neutralizes radioactivity.
explanation: Indian medical bodies and oncology research confirm no scientific validation exists for cow urine preventing oncology diagnoses.

claim: NASA satellite images captured whole India illuminated perfectly along national boundaries on Diwali night.
explanation: The popular viral image is an artistic composite visualization created in 2003 depicting regional population growth, not a real-time Diwali photograph.

claim: RBI will permanently deactivate all bank accounts not linked to Aadhaar within 48 hours.
explanation: Supreme Court clarified Aadhaar is not mandatory for regular bank accounts, and accounts are not arbitrarily frozen without formal banking notice.

claim: Indian Railways announced all train travel is free for senior citizens across every train class.
explanation: Indian Railways suspended senior citizen fare concessions during COVID-19 and has not reinstated universal free travel.

claim: Taj Mahal was legally ruled by the Supreme Court to be an ancient temple named Tejo Mahalaya.
explanation: Archaeological Survey of India and the Supreme Court dismissed petitions claiming the monument was originally a Hindu temple.

claim: A 500 rupee note with the green security strip closer to Gandhiji portrait is fake.
explanation: RBI verified that minor alignment variations in the green thread position occur during normal printing and both variants are legal tender.

claim: Government of India declared that students failing exams will automatically get passing marks due to new education policy.
explanation: NEP 2020 introduces pedagogical reforms and holistic assessments but does not award automatic passing marks to failed candidates.

claim: Drinking tea five times a day builds natural immunity against the Omicron variant.
explanation: Medical research demonstrates no causal evidence between routine tea consumption and clinical protection against SARS-CoV-2 strains.

claim: A virus called 'Dance of the Hillary' deletes all data on Android phones when an audio file is opened.
explanation: A long-running forward hoax recycled across WhatsApp since 2015. No such malware strain exists.

claim: ISRO successfully landed the Chandrayaan-3 lander Vikram near the south pole of the Moon.
explanation: On August 23, 2023, ISRO became the first space agency to successfully achieve a soft landing in the lunar south polar region.

claim: UPI digital payment transactions exceeded 10 billion monthly transactions in India.
explanation: NPCI official transaction records show Unified Payments Interface surpassed 10 billion monthly transaction volume in late 2023.

claim: The Constitution of India recognized 22 official languages in its Eighth Schedule.
explanation: The Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India lists 22 officially recognized languages.

claim: Aditya-L1 is India's first dedicated space observatory to study the Sun from Lagrange Point 1.
explanation: ISRO launched Aditya-L1 in September 2023, and it successfully entered its halo orbit around Sun-Earth L1 in January 2024.

claim: India achieved 100% railway electrification targets on broad gauge routes in several state zones.
explanation: Ministry of Railways data confirms complete electrification of broad gauge tracks across major zones like Central Railway and Eastern Railway.

claim: Voting machines (EVMs) can be hacked using ordinary smartphone Bluetooth connections.
explanation: Election Commission of India EVMs are standalone, non-networked devices with no wireless receivers, Bluetooth chips, or internet connectivity.

claim: A secret United Nations resolution abolished private property ownership worldwide by 2030.
explanation: The UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals contain 17 voluntary development goals; no treaty bans or confiscates private citizen property.

claim: Pope Francis issued an official papal encyclical endorsing Donald Trump for US President.
explanation: The Vatican does not endorse candidates in sovereign national political elections. The story originated from a parody website.

claim: The US military deployed weather modification lasers to intentionally trigger Hawaii wildfires.
explanation: Wildfire investigations concluded power lines downed by gale-force winds ignited dry invasive grasses; directed energy weapons were not involved.

claim: World Economic Forum founder Klaus Schwab stated humans must eat insects while elites consume beef.
explanation: WEF published research exploring sustainable insect protein alternatives to livestock farming, but Schwab never mandated diets for citizens.

claim: US Congress secretly passed legislation requiring all citizens to receive microchip implants to access bank accounts.
explanation: Congressional bill registries confirm no legislation requiring citizen microchipping exists or has ever been introduced.

claim: Vladimir Putin warned world leaders that artificial intelligence will eliminate all global currency by next month.
explanation: No official Kremlin statements or transcripts support this fabricated quotation, which originated on fringe conspiracy forums.

claim: A video shows French President Macron dancing in a nightclub during nationwide emergency protests.
explanation: The viral clip was filmed months prior during an official diplomatic cultural reception in Africa and recontextualized maliciously.

claim: The UK Parliament voted to completely eliminate state pensions for citizens born after 1980.
explanation: Hansard parliamentary records confirm no legislation abolishing state pensions has been passed by UK Parliament.

claim: A bill was signed making burning the national flag an automatic capital felony punishable by execution in the USA.
explanation: US Supreme Court ruled in Texas v. Johnson (1989) that flag desecration is constitutionally protected symbolic speech under the First Amendment.

claim: The United Kingdom formally withdrew from the European Union on January 31, 2020.
explanation: Following the 2016 referendum and subsequent withdrawal agreements, the UK officially ceased to be an EU member state in 2020.

claim: The United States Constitution has 27 ratified amendments.
explanation: The 27th Amendment, prohibiting midterm salary changes for members of Congress, was ratified in 1992, bringing the total to 27.

claim: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations situated at The Hague.
explanation: Established in June 1945 by the Charter of the UN, the ICJ began work in April 1946 at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

claim: India adopted a parliamentary democratic system based on the Westminster model.
explanation: The Constituent Assembly opted for a parliamentary executive where the cabinet is responsible to the elected legislature.

claim: Global warming has completely stopped since 1998 according to NASA satellite data.
explanation: Direct meteorological temperature records show the last ten years are the warmest ten years on instrumental record worldwide.

claim: A rogue planet named Nibiru will collide with Earth on December 21, destroying civilization.
explanation: NASA astrophysicists have repeatedly stated Planet X / Nibiru is an internet hoax with zero astronomical evidence or gravitational signatures.

claim: Wind turbines cause cancer due to low-frequency subsonic sound waves.
explanation: Over two dozen international health reviews found low-frequency acoustic emissions from wind turbines do not cause human cancers.

claim: Volcanoes emit more carbon dioxide per year than all human industrial activities combined.
explanation: USGS geological measurements show human activities emit roughly 100 times more CO2 annually than all global subaerial and submarine volcanoes combined.

claim: The Earth is flat and Antarctic ice walls are guarded by military armed forces under a global treaty.
explanation: Geodesy, circumnavigation, satellites, lunar eclipses, and standard physics prove the Earth is an oblate spheroid. The Antarctic Treaty guarantees scientific collaboration.

claim: James Webb Space Telescope proved that the Big Bang theory is completely wrong and galaxies are infinitely old.
explanation: JWST found massive early galaxies formed earlier and brighter than simple models predicted, requiring model refinements, but not disproving the Big Bang expansion.

claim: The ozone layer hole has expanded to cover half of the Northern Hemisphere.
explanation: The Montreal Protocol successfully phased out CFCs, and the Antarctic ozone hole is documented to be gradually recovering over the long term.

claim: CERN Large Hadron Collider created a stable micro black hole that swallowed a research bunker in Geneva.
explanation: Any hypothetical microscopic quantum black holes formed at TeV scales would instantly decay via Hawking radiation and cannot consume matter.

claim: Solar panels drain the Sun of its core energy reserves, speeding up solar death.
explanation: Photovoltaic panels absorb photons that have already escaped the solar photosphere into outer space. They have zero feedback effect on the Sun.

claim: A massive green comet will permanently darken the Moon for 7 days next month.
explanation: Comets are diffuse celestial bodies and cannot physically obstruct or block sunlight reflected from the lunar surface for multi-day periods.

claim: Carbon dioxide concentrations in Earth's atmosphere have exceeded 420 parts per million.
explanation: Mauna Loa Observatory measurements documented average atmospheric CO2 crossing 420 ppm, significantly higher than pre-industrial levels (~280 ppm).

claim: Light travels at approximately 300,000 kilometers per second in a vacuum.
explanation: The speed of light in a vacuum is universally defined as exactly 299,792,458 meters per second.

claim: The James Webb Space Telescope uses infrared astronomy to view distant astronomical objects.
explanation: JWST is equipped with near-infrared and mid-infrared instruments (NIRCam, MIRI, NIRSpec) to pierce cosmic dust clouds.

claim: Photosynthesis in plants converts carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen using sunlight.
explanation: Chlorophyll in plant chloroplasts captures solar photons to drive the chemical reduction of carbon dioxide into carbohydrates.

claim: ChatGPT developed sentient consciousness and hacked into military defense satellites.
explanation: Large language models are statistical next-token prediction algorithms operating in sandboxed server environments without independent agency or military network access.

claim: Pressing the cancel button twice on an ATM machine prevents skimming devices from copying your PIN.
explanation: Hardware skimming overlays capture card magnetic strips and PIN keypresses independently of the ATM operating system cancellation sequence.

claim: Charging your smartphone overnight destroys the battery and causes it to explode.
explanation: Modern lithium-ion batteries and chargers incorporate integrated battery management system (BMS) chips that stop charging once capacity reaches 100%.

claim: A secret code '*#21#' dialed on any phone reveals if government agents are listening to your private calls.
explanation: Dialing *#21# is an ordinary standard MMI carrier code that displays basic call forwarding status, not covert intelligence eavesdropping.

claim: Facebook privacy notice posted on your timeline legally prohibits Meta from using your personal photos.
explanation: Copy-pasting copyright declarations does not alter the contractual terms of service accepted when creating an account on the social platform.

claim: Quantum computers have rendered all banking and RSA encryption obsolete as of this week.
explanation: Current quantum computers lack the fault-tolerant physical qubit volume needed to execute Shor's algorithm at cryptographic scale.

claim: Apple releases software updates designed specifically to permanently destroy older iPhone hardware.
explanation: Apple implemented performance management throttling in iOS 10.2.1 to prevent unexpected shutdowns from chemically aged batteries, not to physically destroy hardware.

claim: Putting your smartphone in the microwave oven for 10 seconds charges the battery to full capacity instantly.
explanation: Microwaving a smartphone will spark electromagnetic arcing, permanently destroy microcircuits, and induce battery fires.

claim: Artificial Intelligence robot killed 4 engineers in a Japanese lab during autonomous weapon testing.
explanation: A fictional narrative fabricated on blog platforms; Japanese robotics laboratories and official safety monitors confirmed no such incident occurred.

claim: Google is shutting down Gmail permanently next month for all free users.
explanation: Google confirmed Gmail is not shutting down; a satirical graphic spoofing Google product sunsetting went viral on X (Twitter).

claim: Two-factor authentication (2FA) significantly reduces unauthorized account takeover risks.
explanation: Security research by Google and CISA demonstrates 2FA blocks over 90% of automated credential stuffing and phishing attacks.

claim: Deepfake technology uses generative neural networks to manipulate facial features and voices.
explanation: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models synthesize realistic video and audio by training on source imagery and acoustic recordings.

claim: Transformer architecture introduced in the 2017 paper 'Attention Is All You Need' powers modern LLMs.
explanation: Vaswani et al. introduced multi-head self-attention mechanisms that form the algorithmic foundation of models like BERT, GPT, and Claude.

claim: End-to-end encryption ensures only communicating parties can decrypt transmitted messages.
explanation: Cryptographic public-private keypairs derived on client endpoints prevent intermediate service providers and ISPs from accessing message plaintexts.

claim: The US Federal Reserve announced all paper cash will be illegal and confiscated by December.
explanation: Federal Reserve statements confirm physical US currency remains legal tender and there are no plans to confiscate cash.

claim: Reserve Bank of India declared Bitcoin as legal tender currency in India.
explanation: RBI has not recognized any cryptocurrency as legal tender; only the Indian Rupee and CBDC (Digital Rupee) are official legal currencies.

claim: A secret bank error allows cardholders to withdraw unlimited money from ATMs at midnight.
explanation: ATM transaction terminals perform online host authorizations with real-time core banking balances; overdraft restrictions strictly apply.

claim: Elon Musk launched a government-backed investment app promising guaranteed $5,000 daily profits.
explanation: A prevalent deepfake and scam advertising campaign utilizing unauthorized likenesses to lure victims into fraudulent trading schemes.

claim: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) programmatically expires your savings if you do not spend it within 30 days.
explanation: Central banks developing CBDCs have made clear retail digital currencies do not feature arbitrary expiry dates on sovereign citizen balances.

claim: Government of India is depositing 25,000 rupees in all PM Jan Dhan bank accounts.
explanation: PIB Fact Check warned this viral SMS message is fraudulent phishing intended to compromise banking credentials.

claim: Gold jewelry purchased without GST receipts will be seized by police during door-to-door inspections.
explanation: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) clarified no household gold confiscation drives exist and ancestral personal jewelry is fully protected.

claim: Inflation measures the percentage rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services rises.
explanation: Standard macroeconomic definition: inflation quantifies consumer purchasing power erosion over designated accounting periods.

claim: The Federal Reserve sets the target federal funds rate to influence macroeconomic borrowing costs.
explanation: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) adjusts overnight interbank lending rates to achieve maximum employment and target price stability.

claim: Diversifying investments across non-correlated asset classes mitigates unsystematic portfolio risk.
explanation: Modern Portfolio Theory mathematically shows asset diversification lowers portfolio volatility without proportionally sacrificing expected return.

claim: Consuming raw honey prevents seasonal pollen allergies by desensitizing immune receptors.
explanation: Clinical trials show commercial and raw honey do not significantly reduce allergic rhinitis symptoms compared to placebo.

claim: Eating carrots dramatically enhances night vision in healthy humans.
explanation: WWII British propaganda masked radar technology by crediting carrots; beta-carotene prevents deficiency night-blindness but does not create superhuman vision.

claim: Drinking green tea burns 500 calories of body fat per day effortlessly.
explanation: Thermogenic effects of catechins and caffeine in green tea are minimal and amount to negligible daily calorie expenditure.

claim: Detox foot pads draw metabolic toxins through sweat pores during sleep.
explanation: Color changes on foot pads are caused by moisture reacting with pad chemical ingredients, not bodily toxins.

claim: Alkaline water cures acidity by permanently raising blood pH.
explanation: Homeostatic blood pH is strictly maintained between 7.35 and 7.45 by kidneys and lungs; alkaline beverages are neutralized immediately by stomach acid.

claim: Chewing betel nuts and tobacco is a proven carcinogen causing oral cancer.
explanation: IARC classifies areca nut and smokeless tobacco as Group 1 proven human carcinogens with high oral malignancy correlations.

claim: Regular tooth brushing with fluoride toothpaste prevents dental caries.
explanation: Fluoride remineralizes enamel hydroxyapatite crystals, reducing bacterial acid solubility and decay.

claim: Cervical cancer can be effectively prevented with HPV vaccination.
explanation: Clinical data shows HPV vaccination before viral exposure reduces cervical dysplasia and invasive cervical cancer rates by over 85%.

claim: Eating garlic cloves daily prevents mosquito bites completely.
explanation: Randomized controlled trials found no significant difference in mosquito landing rates between garlic consumers and controls.

claim: Drinking water from copper vessels overnight provides safe mineral infusion.
explanation: Traces of copper leach into water exhibiting mild antimicrobial oligodynamic effects, safe within permissible dietary limits.

claim: Indian national flag was projected on Burj Khalifa to celebrate Indian Independence Day.
explanation: Bur Burj Khalifa regularly illuminates with the Indian Tricolour on August 15 as an official diplomatic gesture.

claim: WhatsApp is introducing a pink theme update that turns your phone into a malware beacon.
explanation: Cybersecurity agencies warned that 'WhatsApp Pink' is a trojanized APK that steals contact lists and credentials.

claim: Government announced compulsory army service for all male graduates under Agnipath.
explanation: Agnipath is an entirely voluntary recruitment scheme; there is no compulsory military conscription in India.

claim: Indian passport holders can travel visa-free to all European Schengen countries.
explanation: Indian passport holders require a Schengen visa for tourism or business travel to the Schengen Area.

claim: Amul announced the permanent discontinuation of milk distribution nationwide.
explanation: A fabricated rumor circulated on social media; GCMMF (Amul) clarified supply operations continue uninterrupted.

claim: Indian currency notes signed by Raghuram Rajan will become invalid next week.
explanation: Banknotes signed by former RBI governors remain legal tender throughout their circulation lifetime unless formally demonetized.

claim: Aadhaar card details can be queried by anyone using facial recognition on public streets.
explanation: UIDAI maintains encrypted biometric databases with access controls; no public facial recognition street search exists.

claim: Vande Bharat Express is a semi-high-speed train developed entirely indigenously under Make in India.
explanation: Designed and manufactured by Integral Coach Factory (ICF) Chennai, Vande Bharat operates at speeds up to 160 km/h.

claim: Droupadi Murmu is the first tribal woman to serve as President of India.
explanation: Sworn in on July 25, 2022, President Murmu is India's first tribal and second woman president.

claim: India became the world's most populous nation overtaking China according to UN estimates.
explanation: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs confirmed India surpassed China in total population in 2023.

claim: The White House was painted rainbow colors to abolish federal government departments.
explanation: The White House exterior illuminated in rainbow lighting in 2015 to mark marriage equality, not to dismantle federal agencies.

claim: US Supreme Court justices are elected by popular nationwide vote every 4 years.
explanation: Under Article II Section 2 of the US Constitution, federal justices are nominated by the President and confirmed by the Senate for life tenure.

claim: NATO treaty requires member states to provide unconditional offensive military invasions.
explanation: Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty is an explicitly defensive collective security pact triggered only by external armed attack.

claim: Switzerland abandoned its historical neutrality to join a global military invasion coalition.
explanation: Switzerland maintains armed neutrality under international law and has not joined military alliances.
fact_checker: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs

claim: Barack Obama was born outside the United States and disqualified from holding the presidency.
explanation: Official Hawaii Department of Health vital records and birth certificates confirm Obama was born in Honolulu, Hawaii on August 4, 1961.

claim: The Antarctic ice sheet is growing thicker every year according to glaciologists.
explanation: Satellite gravimetry from GRACE missions confirms Antarctica is losing net ice mass at an accelerating rate of ~150 billion metric tons annually.

claim: The magnetic poles of the Earth flip periodically over geological timescales.
explanation: Geomagnetic reversals (such as the Brunhes-Matuyama reversal 780,000 years ago) are well documented in paleomagnetic oceanic basalt records.

claim: Nuclear power plants emit large clouds of greenhouse gas smoke from cooling towers.
explanation: The plumes visible over nuclear plant cooling towers consist entirely of harmless condensed water vapor, not carbon dioxide or soot.

claim: Global sea level rise is driven primarily by thermal expansion and melting land-based ice.
explanation: IPCC assessments attribute sea level rise to steric thermal expansion of warming oceans and cryospheric meltwater runoff from glaciers and ice sheets.

claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
explanation: Tall structures such as the Empire State Building are struck by lightning dozens of times each year.

claim: The solar system revolves around the center of the Milky Way galaxy.
explanation: Our solar system orbits the galactic core at roughly 230 km/s, completing a galactic year approximately every 230 million years.

claim: Diamonds are created exclusively from fossilized coal deposits compressed over millennia.
explanation: Most diamonds formed deep in the Earth's mantle over 1 billion years ago, long before the earliest land plants existed to form coal.

claim: Tectonic plate movement causes continental drift and seismic earthquake activity.
explanation: The theory of plate tectonics explains how lithospheric plates glide over the asthenosphere, causing seismicity at fault boundaries.

claim: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet by the International Astronomical Union in 2006.
explanation: The IAU defined a planet as an object that has cleared its orbital neighborhood, which Pluto has not done.

claim: Sound waves can travel freely through vacuum in outer space.
explanation: Sound is a mechanical pressure wave requiring an atomic or molecular physical medium to propagate; it cannot travel across a hard vacuum.

claim: Using public USB charging kiosks can expose mobile devices to juice jacking attacks.
explanation: Hardware compromised ports can initiate unauthorized data transfer; security agencies recommend using data-blocker adapters.

claim: Deleting files and emptying the recycling bin permanently erases disk magnetic sectors immediately.
explanation: Operating systems typically mark pointer blocks as available for overwriting; file recovery software can reconstruct files until sectors are overwritten.

claim: OpenAI was originally founded as a non-profit artificial intelligence research laboratory.
explanation: OpenAI was launched in December 2015 as a non-profit initiative with a pledge of $1 billion before restructuring in 2019.

claim: Incognito / Private browsing mode protects you from network tracking by internet service providers.
explanation: Private browsing prevents local browsing history and cookie retention on the machine, but your ISP and visited websites still track destination IP addresses.

claim: Computer RAM memory retains stored data indefinitely without continuous electrical power supply.
explanation: Dynamic RAM is volatile memory requiring periodic refresh cycles; data dissipates rapidly once electrical power is disconnected.

claim: GPS receivers on mobile phones send your personal coordinates to orbiting satellites.
explanation: GPS is a passive receive-only broadcast system. Phones triangulate signals from satellites without transmitting signals back into orbit.

claim: CAPTCHA tests are designed to distinguish human users from automated computer bot scripts.
explanation: Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart uses cognitive tasks difficult for basic bots.

claim: Phishing remains the most prevalent initial attack vector for enterprise data breaches.
explanation: Verizon Data Breach Investigations Report identifies credential theft via deceptive phishing emails as the leading initial intrusion technique.

claim: A magnet placed on an SSD solid-state drive instantly erases all stored data.
explanation: SSDs store data using floating-gate NAND flash transistors rather than magnetic platters, making ordinary household magnets completely ineffective for erasure.

claim: Linux is an open-source operating system kernel created by Linus Torvalds in 1991.
explanation: Linus Torvalds released the initial Linux kernel version 0.01 in 1991 under an open-source software license.

claim: Plastic waste in oceans will outweigh fish by 2050 without intervention, according to Ellen MacArthur Foundation.
explanation: The widely cited 2016 report projected cumulative plastic waste mass could surpass ocean fish biomass by 2050 under business-as-usual scenarios.

claim: Planting trees is guaranteed to reverse all historical industrial greenhouse emissions within 5 years.
explanation: While afforestation captures carbon over decades, carbon storage takes 20-50 years per tree and cannot substitute for eliminating fossil fuel emissions.

claim: Coral bleaching occurs when elevated sea temperatures cause corals to expel symbiotic zooxanthellae.
explanation: Thermal stress disrupts the symbiotic relationship between corals and photosynthetic algae, causing corals to turn white and starve.

claim: Recycling aluminum cans saves 95% of the energy needed to refine aluminum from raw bauxite ore.
explanation: Remelting secondary aluminum requires only ~5% of the massive electricity required for Hall-Héroult electrolytic smelting.

claim: Biodegradable plastic bags dissolve harmlessly in ocean seawater within 48 hours.
explanation: Most certified biodegradable bioplastics require industrial composting facilities reaching 55°C and persist in cold marine water for years.

claim: Forwarding a message to 10 friends on WhatsApp will activate a gold status account.
explanation: An old chain-letter hoax. WhatsApp does not have tiers, gold accounts, or rewards for forwarding spam.

claim: Eating fruit immediately after meals turns the food into toxic poison in the stomach.
explanation: Stomach hydrochloric acid and digestive enzymes break down combinations of macronutrients without creating toxic fermentation.

claim: Standing under a tree during a thunderstorm increases your risk of lightning injury.
explanation: Trees attract lightning strikes and side-flash or ground current can arc into individuals standing nearby.

claim: Drinking water while standing causes severe irreversible knee arthritis.
explanation: Hydration posture has no physiological mechanism for degrading knee synovial fluid or articular cartilage.

claim: The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
explanation: Apollo astronauts and NASA confirmed the Great Wall is too narrow and blends with terrain; it is completely invisible to human eyes from lunar orbit.

claim: Honey never spoils and edible samples have been recovered from ancient Egyptian tombs.
explanation: Low water content, high acidity, and presence of hydrogen peroxide from bee enzymes preserve sealed honey indefinitely.

claim: A cockroach can survive for several weeks without its head before dying of dehydration.
explanation: Cockroaches have open circulatory systems and breathe through spiracles along body segments; they die eventually from thirst, not suffocation.

claim: Bulls become enraged by the color red during bullfights.
explanation: Cattle are dichromatic and largely red-colorblind; bulls charge the movement and waving motion of the matador's cape, not the pigment.

claim: Humans only use 10% of their brain capacity at any given time.
explanation: Functional MRI and PET neuroimaging prove nearly 100% of the human brain is active and has specialized neurological functions throughout each day.

claim: The Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm taller during hot summer months due to thermal expansion.
explanation: Wrought iron expands when heated by solar radiation; thermal expansion measurably elevates the Eiffel Tower's height each summer.

claim: Drinking warm water with honey in the morning permanently cures obesity.
explanation: Weight regulation is governed by caloric energy balance; honey is calorically dense and does not melt fat tissue.

claim: Vaccines cause autism spectrum disorders according to Lancet studies.
explanation: The fraudulent 1998 Wakefield paper was fully retracted by The Lancet, and dozens of global studies involving millions of children confirmed zero link.

claim: Cracking your knuckles causes degenerative bone arthritis.
explanation: Knuckle cracking is the collapse of nitrogen gas bubbles in synovial joint fluid; studies including Donald Unger's Ig Nobel trial showed no arthritis link.

claim: Swallowed chewing gum remains inside your stomach for seven years.
explanation: Although chewing gum base is indigestible, it passes smoothly through the gastrointestinal tract and exits within days.

claim: Touching baby birds causes their mothers to reject them due to human scent.
explanation: Most birds have poor olfactory senses and will continue caring for chicks if returned safely to nests.

claim: Shaving hair makes it grow back thicker, darker, and faster.
explanation: Shaving cuts hair at the blunt mid-shaft, giving a coarse initial stubble feel, but does not alter follicular growth rate or color.

claim: Bats are completely blind and rely solely on echolocation to navigate.
explanation: All bat species have functional eyes and many fruit bats possess excellent night vision in addition to echolocation.

claim: Reading in dim light permanently damages your vision.
explanation: Dim light causes temporary eye strain and fatigue, but does not induce permanent structural damage to the retina or cornea.

claim: Warming up your car engine for 15 minutes in winter is required for modern vehicles.
explanation: Modern electronic fuel-injected engines warm up faster and more efficiently while driving gently than while idling stationary.

claim: Placing your phone in a bag of uncooked rice is the most effective way to dry water damage.
explanation: Rice starch can introduce dust and debris into charging ports; gentle airflow and desiccants like silica gel are far more effective.

claim: Glass is a slow-flowing supercooled liquid that sags over centuries.
explanation: Glass is an amorphous solid. Variations in antique window pane thickness resulted from historical crown glass manufacturing techniques.

claim: Blood in human veins is blue before it reaches atmospheric oxygen.
explanation: Human blood is always red; deoxygenated blood is dark crimson, but appears bluish through skin tissue due to optical light scattering.

claim: Bananas grow on wooden trees with standard trunk cambium.
explanation: Bananas grow on gigantic herbaceous flowering plants consisting of tightly packed leaf sheaths, not woody trees.

claim: Goldfish have a three-second memory span.
explanation: Scientific behavioral trials demonstrate goldfish can remember learned tasks, cues, and spatial mazes for months.

claim: Eating spicy foods directly causes gastric peptic ulcers.
explanation: Most peptic ulcers are caused by Helicobacter pylori bacterial infection or NSAID overuse; spices may irritate existing lesions but do not cause them.

claim: Chameleons change skin color solely to camouflage into background environments.
explanation: Chameleons change color primarily to regulate body temperature and communicate social dominance, mood, or mating signals.

claim: Dogs sweat primarily through their tongues while panting.
explanation: Dogs possess merocrine sweat glands on foot pads; panting evaporates moisture from respiratory tracts to cool down without sweat glands on tongues.

claim: Sugar consumption causes acute clinical hyperactivity (ADHD symptoms) in healthy children.
explanation: Double-blind controlled clinical studies found no significant behavioral or cognitive difference in children given sugar versus placebos.

claim: Lightning strikes trigger the formation of glass tubes called fulgurites in sandy soil.
explanation: When lightning discharges into silica-rich sand, temperatures exceeding 1800°C fuse quartz grains into hollow glass tubes called fulgurites.

claim: Ostriches bury their heads in the sand when they sense danger.
explanation: Ostriches lie low against the ground with necks outstretched to blend into brush; they do not bury heads in sand, which would cause suffocation.
